diagnostic_gate: At least 3 training-inlier tiles, >=80% held-out matches within 5 px, held-out median <=5 px. Descriptive gate applied to diagnostics; independently identified stable controls still required.
interpretation: Repeated archive rows can refer to the same raster component. Their cause is unresolved (e.g. track branching or duplicate assignment); do not count them as independent individuals.
